videos.title: Security Forge + Apollo: Complete Domain Assurance at Scale | Accenture at AIPCon 10
videos.description:
At AIPCon 10, Accenture CISO Kris Burkhardt shares Security Forge and Apollo — a closed-loop agentic cybersecurity system built with Palantir to defend software estates at machine speed. 

See how Accenture is deploying specialized agent pipelines to hunt vulnerabilities across entire codebases, surface findings to human engineers for adjudication, automate remediation with agent swarms and deploy patches across the fleet with Apollo — outpacing increasingly sophisticated adversarial attacks.

videos.title: Delivering AI to Every Farmer in America | USDA at AIPCon 10
videos.description: At AIPCon 10, USDA Chief Information Officer Sam Berry reveals how Palantir turned hundreds of fragmented legacy systems into a single, governed Ontology — USDA’s "One Farmer, One File" initiative. See how the Landmark platform is transforming American farming, from AI-assisted acreage reporting to the fastest deployment of capital to farmers in USDA history through the Farmer Bridge Assistance Program.

videos.title: Orchestrating Fleet-Wide Operational Excellence | Hertz at AIPCon 10
videos.description: At AIPCon 10, Hertz reveals how Palantir AIP powers Daytona — a control tower orchestrating fleet operations across half a million vehicles in real time. See how collaborating agents traverse the Ontology at VIN-level granularity to triage safety events, plan maintenance, optimize transportation, and assign vehicles to customers — turning 4 million monthly operational touchpoints into connected, cross-functional decisions that optimize the entire system, not just individual departments.

videos.title: Pioneering AI for Private Equity Fundraising | Kirkland & Ellis at AIPCon 10
videos.description: At AIPCon 10, Kirkland & Ellis unveils the Fund Formation Engine, a new operating model for legal services, built on Palantir. See how Kirkland is centralizing decades of institutional knowledge from over 1,000 lawyers and embedding it directly into the fundraising lifecycle — from document drafting and investor comment management to side letter generation and long-term obligation tracking, ensuring every judgment call is informed by the best possible underlying knowledge. Better outcomes, with maximal efficiency.

videos.title: Deploying 160 Years of Tradecraft to Every Project | McCarthy Building Companies at AIPCon 10
videos.description: At AIPCon 10, McCarthy Building Companies reveals how Palantir AIP is transforming construction operations through Pulse, a mission control for operations intelligence built on the McCarthy Ontology, encompassing more than 160 years of construction experience. See how superintendents team with AI agents to surface risks across 5,000 concurrent activities, scenario plan against schedule and procurement impacts, and manage stakeholder communications — all from one place, allowing them to focus where they’re needed on the job site.

videos.title: Securing Software Distribution in the Age of AI | Apollo In the Field at AIPCon 10
videos.description: At AIPCon 10, Palantir pulls back the curtain on Apollo, the deployment infrastructure behind every Foundry and AIP installation. In a world where vibe coding is shipping more code than ever before and adversaries are finding vulnerabilities at unprecedented scale, having a system that can roll back, remediate, and re-deploy across any substrate is a security imperative.

videos.title: From Paper Schedules to AI Workforce Orchestration | Mixology In the Field at AIPCon 10
videos.description: At AIPCon 10, the CEO of Mixology speaks about going through analyst training after a burn-the-boats moment forced him to charge to the front lines. What started as a workforce scheduling problem became something far bigger: encoding 16 years of tribal business knowledge into the Ontology, building dozens of applications and agents, and solving in an afternoon what once cost hundreds of thousands or even millions of dollars.

videos.title: Building the Operating System for Modern Air Mobility | Surf Air In the Field at AIPCon 10
videos.description: At AIPCon 10, Surf Air's team walks through how they built Surf OS — a connected operating system for air mobility — on Palantir Foundry and AIP. Fuel optimization stood up in weeks. A real-time control tower now gives operations, maintenance, and flight leadership instant situational awareness. An AIP-powered pricing engine spans thousands of flights. What once took days and entire teams now takes minutes, and connected aircraft are next.

videos.title: Decreasing Token Usage by Nearly 60% | McCarthy Building Companies In the Field at AIPCon 10
videos.description: At AIPCon 10, McCarthy, a 160-year-old general contractor, shares how they are using Palantir to token-min and value-max, while simultaneously creating cohesion across 200+ applications. By deploying the Ontology as the connective layer across their entire project lifecycle, they are driving near-60% reductions in token usage through Evolve and restructuring their digital organization to move fast while maintaining the governance controls that a 5,000-person operation demands.
